title: fix(objectql): a read answers a selected declared column the driver did not return as null (#29408)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9FsseX1D55aTkD3vCGCNK9E)_
Fixes #29408

Clause-②: no — measured on base and head: every read returns the same rows and the same values, nothing a request may send is refused or newly admitted; only a record body gains a `null` key for a stored declared column the read selected and the driver returned no key for.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：引擎读路径（`find` / `findOne`）对"本次读取选中的已声明列"补齐键：驱动没返回该键时答 `null`，mongo / memory 与 SQL 的同一条记录读出来一样了。
- 为什么改：同一条记录按驱动读出两种形状（SQL 给 `null`，mongo / memory 缺键），客户端 `has(record.x)` 结果随驱动变；#29094 裁决选项 A 的后续 D.1。
- 风险与回滚：只在读响应上多出值为 `null` 的键；未选中的列、FLS 拒读的列、公式字段、未声明的名字、联邦对象无存储的注入列都仍然缺席。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/declared-read-columns.ts`（`selectedStoredColumns`），`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` 两处调用，`packages/runtime/src/declared-column-null-on-read.test.ts`（FLS 钉）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/selected-declared-columns-answered.test.ts`，预期 14 条全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `declared-read-columns.ts` gains the declared-set twin of `withDeclaredColumnsOnly`: `selectedStoredColumns(schema, projection)` (the stored declared columns a read selected: the whole declared set with no projection, else the declared columns the projection names) and `withSelectedColumnsAnswered` / `rowsWithSelectedColumnsAnswered` (answer each selected column the row does not carry as `null`; never mutate the driver's row).
- `engine.ts` calls it once per read verb, right after the existing `#21571` shaping, on the projection the DRIVER was handed (`driverAst.fields`), so a `beforeFind` rewrite counts and the engine's own formula / file-owner widening is cut back off the answer as before.
- Stays absent: a column the projection does not name; a `formula` field ahead of its formula (it keeps its computed value); a name outside the declared set; an injected column a federated (`external`) object does not provision (`unprovisionedInjectedColumns`); a column field-level security refuses (the security middleware's mask deletes it after the verb's body, as before).
- Every door on `find` / `findOne` shares it: `GET /data/:object/:id` and `POST /data/:object/query` / the list route (`protocol-record-reads.ts`, `getData` / `findData`), `expand` sub-reads (`expandRelatedRecords` calls `this.find`), export and search. `readUpdatePriorRow` (the update's prior-row read) and the write echoes (insert / update / delete answers) are not changed.
- `@objectstack/objectql` patch changeset, with who sees it and how.

## Tests

- New `packages/objectql/src/selected-declared-columns-answered.test.ts` (14): a sparse driver (stores only written keys, projects as MongoDB does — the driver-memory / driver-mongodb shape) through `find`, `findOne`, `getData` and `findData`; negative pins for not-selected, outside-the-declared-set and federated; formula kept; stored row never mutated.
- New `packages/runtime/src/declared-column-null-on-read.test.ts` (6): driver-sql (SQLite) with `SecurityPlugin` composed and a member denied `secret`: whole read, list read, naming projection answer `note: null`; a non-naming projection leaves it absent; the FLS-refused `secret` stays absent on every read shape; a system read of the same row answers `secret: null` (control).
- New `packages/drivers/driver-mongodb/src/mongodb-declared-column-null-on-read.test.ts` (4): driver-mongodb through the engine on its fake `Db` (no server, see Verification).
- Forced test edits, each because a test-double row lacks a declared column that a whole read now answers `null`:
  - `engine.test.ts`, Expand Related Records, five cases (`should expand lookup fields by replacing IDs with full objects`, `… a user field …`, `… nested expand where-filter …`, `… master_detail fields`, `… only fields specified in the expand map …`): the expanded record's expectation gains `created_at: null, updated_at: null`.
  - `engine-formula-projection-trim.test.ts`, `CONTROL: a read with no projection is unchanged` (find and findOne): gains `queue: null` (registry-injected, absent from the stored fixture).
  - `federated-injected-column-readers.test.ts` (not a moved expectation, a census row the gate requires): one row for the new `selectedStoredColumns :: unprovisionedInjectedColumns()` seam, disposition `excludes`.

## Acceptance notes

- driver-memory has no committed real-driver pin: binding it in a new test file is a new consumer under `check:driver-memory-census` (a maintainer ruling, #6664). Its shape is pinned by the objectql sparse driver, and the base reading below was taken with a probe that is not kept.
- The write echoes stay sparse on mongo / memory (an insert's returned record carries no key for an unwritten field; SQL's carries `null`). Out of this card's read scope; named, not filed.

## Verification

<details><summary>Step 0 — base (`aca58cdb6`) reading, row inserted as `{ name }` on an object that also declares `note`</summary>

| read | SQLite | memory | mongo (fake `Db`) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| findOne, no projection | `note: null` | no key | no key |
| findOne `fields: [name, note]` | `note: null` | no key | no key |
| findOne `fields: [name]` | no key | no key | no key |
| find, no projection | `note: null` | no key | no key |
| find `fields: [name, note]` | `note: null` | no key | no key |

Real mongod: NOT MEASURED. The conda-forge MongoDB 8.3.7 package downloaded and matched its published sha256 (`eaa4aba5…`), but running it was refused in this session, so mongo was read through the driver's own fake `Db`, whose projection answers as mongod does (named keys the document has, no key for one it lacks).
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each: mutate through `ablation-replace.mjs`, red, restore, `git diff HEAD` empty)</summary>

- A1 projection ignored (`selectedStoredColumns` returns the whole stored set): `selected-declared-columns-answered.test.ts` 3 red (NOT SELECTED …, OUTSIDE THE DECLARED SET …, own-key-undefined), restored.
- A2 declared intersection removed: 1 red (OUTSIDE THE DECLARED SET stays absent), restored.
- A4 federated exclusion removed: 1 red (FEDERATED stays absent), restored.
- A3 fill moved to `find`'s exit, after the security mask (runtime reads objectql `dist/`: rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight` marker present in 4 built files; restore leg rebuilt, marker absent from all 14): `declared-column-null-on-read.test.ts` 2 red (`FLS-REFUSED stays absent …`, `NOT SELECTED stays absent …`), green leg 6/6.
</details>

<details><summary>Suites (head `b38c2360`; dogfood on `7daf9652`, the only later commit is a driver-mongodb test file outside the dogfood closure)</summary>

- `@objectstack/objectql` test: 534/534 files, 10328/10328 tests.
- `@objectstack/rest` test: 371/371 files, 7032 passed, 332 skipped.
- `@objectstack/driver-mongodb` test: 34 files passed, 5 skipped (mongod-gated); 725 passed, 190 skipped.
- `@objectstack/driver-memory` test: 74/74 files, 1767/1767.
- typecheck: objectql, runtime, driver-mongodb exit 0.
- lint (root eslint on objectql, runtime, driver-mongodb, `--no-inline-config`): exit 0.
- dogfood battery (`7daf9652`, closure built, under the lock): VERDICT command-exit 1 · Test Files 2 failed / 395 passed / 3 skipped (400) · Tests 4 failed / 3261 passed / 28 skipped (3293). The 4 failures are not this change's: `flow-runas.dogfood.test.ts` (3, the member's flow trigger answers `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND`) and `declarative-endpoint-anonymous-guest.dogfood.test.ts` (1). Control: the same two files with the new fill disabled at both call sites (objectql rebuilt, marker in `dist/`) fail the same 4 of 12; restored and rebuilt after.
- derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands`, run on `b38c2360` after the last commit): 64/64 exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 64 derived, 64 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Prerequisites fetched or built first: the teardown self-test's pinned fixture commit, and the seven packages `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` reads.
</details>
